scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names server,client "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.dev:lan: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names server,client "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client -- --host"
scripts.test: npm run test:bootstrap && npm run test:hooks && npm run test -w server && npm run test -w cli && npm run test -w client --if-present
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w cli && npm run build -w client
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w server && npm run lint -w cli
scripts.desktop:dev: npm run build -w client && npm --prefix desktop run dev
scripts.desktop:dist: npm run build -w client && npm --prefix desktop run dist
scripts.desktop:dist:mac:x64: npm run build -w client && npm --prefix desktop run dist:mac:x64
scripts.desktop:dist:win: npm run build -w client && npm --prefix desktop run dist:win
scripts.desktop:dist:linux: npm run build -w client && npm --prefix desktop run dist:linux
